keyword: S-tube large end seal and small end seal

title.en: How Pinjin separates S-tube large-end and small-end seals
title.zh: 品锦如何分开 S 管大端和小端密封

description.en: The Xingtai S-tube seal page lists large-end kits at φ210, φ220 and φ250, and small-end kits at φ80, φ90, φ100 and φ105. The two ends are different rows.
description.zh: 邢台 S 管密封页把大端套件列为 φ210、φ220、φ250，小端套件列为 φ80、φ90、φ100、φ105。两端是不同的行。

h1.en: S-tube large-end seals and small-end seals
h1.zh: S管大端密封和小端密封

directAnswer.en: An S-tube seal from Hebei Pinjin Machinery is a set for one end of the S-tube. Large end and small end are both on the same product page and they are not interchangeable rows. No pump model is named.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械的 S 管密封是 S 管一端用的套件。大端和小端写在同一张产品页上，但不是可以互换的行。没有点名泵型号。

body.en: Large end: φ210, φ220, φ250. The φ220 row includes six-piece kits. Small end: φ80, φ90, φ100, φ105. The page also says some large-end kits are six-piece sets; the size row that states this is φ220. Material and life are missing.
body.zh: 大端：φ210、φ220、φ250。φ220 那一行包含六件套。小端：φ80、φ90、φ100、φ105。页面还说部分大端为六件套；写明这一点的尺寸行是 φ220。材料和寿命缺失。

heading.en: Numbers that belong to other parts

body.en: φ80 here is a small-end seal, not the DN80 clamp and not Electric 20's 80 mm pipe. φ100 here is not the 100 / 125 mm pipe cell. A swing-cylinder seal also uses φ80 and φ90 on its own page.
body.zh: 这里的 φ80 是小端密封，不是 DN80 管卡，也不是电动20的 80 mm 管子。这里的 φ100 不是 100 / 125 mm 管径格。摆缸密封在自己的页面也使用 φ80 和 φ90。

body.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write large end or small end before the diameter.
body.zh: 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 在直径前面写明大端或小端。

question.en: Can one kit cover both ends?
question.zh: 一套能同时覆盖两端吗？

answer.en: The page lists the ends as separate rows. It does not print a combined two-end kit.
answer.zh: 页面把两端分成不同的行。没有印出两端合并的一套。

answer.en: The φ220 large-end row. Do not copy that count onto φ210, φ250 or the small-end rows.
answer.zh: φ220 大端那一行。不要把这个件数抄到 φ210、φ250 或小端各行。

answer.en: This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine.
answer.zh: 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。

answer.en: A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank.
answer.zh: 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。

label.en: Email or WhatsApp the Xingtai factory
label.zh: 邮件或 WhatsApp 联系邢台工厂
